title: Phuket airport stays
sub: 8 places to crash before the HCMC flight, Nov 2026
tip: Airport is ~5–10 min by car from all of these. Walking works for the Mai Khao/Soi Naiyang ones but the road has poor pavements — grab a taxi with a big bag. Planes are loud by day, quiet late night.

places.name: Sugar Marina Resort – Aviator
notes: Best all-rounder: ~5 min drive, aviation-themed, big comfy beds
Breakfast worth adding; walls can be thin

places.name: The Luna Hostel
notes: Top-rated cheapie: ~10 min walk to terminal, privates + dorms
Pool, free coffee, breakfast, bikes to borrow

places.name: The Snug Airportel
notes: ~1 km from airport, 24h pool, welcomes 1am check-ins
Privates and dorms; ask for a bottom bunk

places.name: Seapines Villa Liberg
notes: Charming Thai-style boutique round a pool, near Nai Yang beach

places.name: Nai Yang Beach Resort & Spa
notes: Across the road from the beach, food and bars a minute away
Back rooms are a long walk; thin walls

places.name: The Sixteenth Naiyang Beach Hotel
notes: Free hourly airport shuttle, rooftop pool with plane views

places.name: Hop On Phuket
notes: 5–10 min walk to the terminal, clean, huge bed, quiet
Plain exterior, ring the video bell

places.name: Phuket Airport Place
notes: Closest of the lot, but busy road to cross on foot
Airport drop is 200 THB, not free
